basis: Covenant Logistics Group’s April 27 earnings release was the earliest qualifying issuer communication I found. Its GAAP table reports consolidated total revenue, including fuel surcharges, of $266,851,000 for the three months ended March 31, 2023, versus $291,585,000 a year earlier. That was an 8.5% decline and $10,154,750 below the $277,005,750 threshold. The Lew Thompson & Son acquisition took effect April 26, after quarter-end, so it contributed no Q1 revenue.

coverage.detail: October 20, 2022, Q3 release. Management expected weaker demand into 2023. Its billion-dollar revenue indication covered full-year 2022, and its quarterly margin outlook covered Q4 2022. Neither established a Q1 2023 revenue ceiling.

October 21 Q3 call. Covenant’s prepared remarks discussed segment operating trends, fleet reductions and expected Q4 margin improvement. I found no numerical Q1 2023 consolidated revenue outlook in the remarks or call discussion.

January 25, 2023, Q4 release. Management expected a difficult freight market through at least the first half of 2023 and possible pressure on rates and margins. Its approximately $8 million Q1 estimate was a pretax gain on a terminal sale. The release gave no upper bound for Q1 consolidated revenue.

January 26 Q4 call, management remarks transcribed by MarketBeat. Management discussed weak volumes, contract pricing and a return to mid-single-digit brokerage margins. I found no forecast bounding Q1 consolidated revenue.
January 31 release. The $55 million figure was the amended share-repurchase authorization. The accompanying trading plan supplied no revenue guidance.
February 16 release. Covenant raised its quarterly dividend to $0.11 per share and gave no Q1 revenue estimate.

The 2022 annual report and shareholder letter discussed the 2023 fleet replacement cycle, capital spending and liquidity. I found no Q1 consolidated revenue ceiling there. Searches outside EDGAR for intervening investor presentations, management remarks and preliminary results also located no qualifying update.
April 14 Form 8-K. Item 5.02 announced director nominations, an employee retirement and a director’s decision to step down. It supplied no Q1 operating results or revenue guidance.

April 27 issuer release. The dateline identifies the March 31 quarter, gives April 26 as the acquisition’s effective date and schedules the results call for April 28. The same-day SEC exhibit supplies the precise GAAP figures.
EDGAR records acceptance of the results Form 8-K at 16:13:49 on April 27 and identifies Exhibit 99.1 as the April 27 press release.

publication_date_evidence: The issuer’s release is datelined April 27, 2023, and says Covenant announced the results that day. EDGAR independently confirms same-day public filing of the release, before the April 28 earnings call and the May 5 Form 10-Q.
